_about: Kelpie's demo (mods/kelpie/demo.js). `herdr-app do kelpie.demo` makes the Acme profile and opens these spaces; edit this file and press Refresh to change what it shows; `herdr-app do kelpie.demo-github` shows the same issues as a GitHub Project (`project`), `kelpie.demo` puts Jira back; `herdr-app do kelpie.demo-remove` takes it all away. Times are relative: -25m, -3h, -2d. A tab's `work` ({prompt, edits: [{path, at}]}, paths under the profile's folder) is what its agent started on and the files it changed, as the plugin's find_agents reads them from a session; two agents here changed web/src/theme/tokens.ts in the same folder. A pull request's `later` ({after: seconds, checks…}) takes its place that long after kelpie.demo ran, so a change can be watched reaching the list; one with `opens` ({after, found}) is opened by an agent `after` seconds in and found by GitHub's search only `found` seconds in. Its links can't reach anyone: Jira at jira.example.com (reserved for examples), GitHub as kelpie--demo (GitHub allows no double hyphen in a name). Its Claude Artifacts (`artifacts`, by the session that published them, as artifacts.py gives them; `account`: the Claude config folder it was made on, when not the profile's) are claude.ai links whose ids name no Artifact (demo-…).
_moved: An issue's `moved` (relative) is when it last moved on the board, as Jira and a Project give it: the stories handed over or done are ordered by it, the latest first (ACME-122 two hours ago, then ACME-129's subtask three days ago; Done: ACME-116, then ACME-118). Unset: the board says nothing.
_priorities: The board's priority levels, highest first (Jira's site list, the Project's Priority field's options); each issue's `priority` names one, ACME-138 and its subtask none. The profile shows them once its board's byPriority/showPriority are on (the profile dialog's Board page, or `byPriority`/`showPriority` true in `profile` here).

issues.description:
Travellers open saved trips on planes, trains and in roaming dead zones. Today the trip screen shows a spinner and then an error when there's no network, even for trips that were opened a minute ago.

## What we want

Saved trips open instantly from the device, and changes made offline (notes, reordered stops, a new booking) are kept and synced once the connection is back.

- Cache every trip the traveller opened in the last 30 days in `IndexedDB`
- Queue edits made offline and replay them in order
- Show a calm banner while offline, never a blocking error

## Out of scope

Downloading map tiles: that's ACME-190.

## Done when

1. A trip opened once opens again in airplane mode, within 300 ms
2. An edit made offline shows on another device a minute after going back online
3. Conflicts keep the newest change and say so in the trip's history
